capabilities: Blur selected note elements via presets
Select elements through a visual picker with real-time preview
disambiguation: Not an appearance theme or CSS snippet manager; it only applies a blur effect to selected elements.
extras: Manual installation folder is documented as 'obsidian-blur' while the plugin id is 'aqu-blur-mode', which could confuse manual installs; a future-plans list mentions multiple presets, keyboard shortcuts, and preset export/import as not yet implemented.
motivation: Keeping privacy, per the description and stated purpose of blurring elements for privacy or focus.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide or blur sensitive note content when sharing your screen or demonstrating the app to others.
summary: Blur tool that lets you selectively blur elements in notes via saved presets, keyword matching, and an adjustable blur amount.
